E2815

`app.caller()` is reached from {root}, which acts for no signed-in account.

What

`app.caller()` is reached from {root}, which acts for no signed-in account.

Why

`app.caller()` gives the signed-in account, so it is accepted only on a path that starts at an `#App.SignedIn` method or inside `app.as_caller`; an `#App.Public` method, a webhook, a job, a schedule, a spawned task and the program's own entry act for no account. The path: {path}.

Fix

Read `app.maybe_caller()` and handle `None`, mark the method that starts the path `#App.SignedIn`, or in a test run the call inside `app.as_caller(account, …)`.

Worked example
